sources.version_or_commit: Current published URL, accessed 2026-10-10; no pinned version in URL

sources.observed_operation: Read permission, track lifecycle, device enumeration, and sampleRate constraint/settings sections
sources.condition_default_exception: Permission/device errors reject getUserMedia; mute is temporary; ended covers revocation/device removal; devicechange reports changed device set; sampleRate can be exact/ideal and actual settings are read from getSettings(); stop() is own cleanup and does not fire ended.
sources.applicability: Microphone-only permission/start behavior, mute/ended/input changes, cleanup.
